versions.localizedDescription:
### Fixed
- Calls now carry sound both ways. Answering from the full-screen ringing
  page could set the call up twice, which left one side with no sound and
  video going only one way.
- Speaker and earpiece switching works during a call. Video calls start on the
  loudspeaker instead of the quiet earpiece.
- A second call after the first one no longer starts silent.
- The other person's video shows reliably once the call connects.
- If a call can't be answered on this phone, the caller hears so at once
  instead of ringing until it times out.
- iPhone: calls answered from the ringing screen have sound.
